'''2022 EGP Benji Jones LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Benji Jones]] at [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Benji Jones]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
